spec.name: Halloween Haunted Fishing Pond
spec.description: An original Orange SMP Halloween pond with a square weathered stone rim, shallow midnight teal water, four small cattail clusters and a pale skull resting on the rear edge. Axis-aligned, editable geometry within x/z 0–32 and y 0–8. Transparent negative space surrounds the plants and ornament; no fish, text or animation.

prompt: Square stone-rimmed shallow magical pond with midnight teal water, small cattails in corners and a skull ornament. No fish. x,z0..32 y0..8. Original Orange SMP Halloween asset. Vanilla Minecraft pixel scale, material-specific irregular detail, developed UV-mapped surfaces and purposeful connected cuboids. No text, no unrelated scene, no stands, no animations, no bones except the required armor rig. Preserve transparent negative space. Model geometry must be axis-aligned, with no rotated elements. Use local vanilla references for glass, pumpkin rind, wood, iron and inventory sprites. Generated artwork will be used directly in a Paper resource pack.
